Lena (Partnerships): quick sync — ToolSmith (ISV) wants to publish a bundled listing: their LangChain adapter + our gateway + an orchestration sample. they also asked about telemetry/usage export for co-marketing metrics. cc @Omar @Yuki

Omar (Eng): okay. tech asks: 1) adapter registration API + sample manifest, 2) webhook callback with HMAC, 3) small SDK example showing reconnection/backoff. I can draft a minimal manifest + node/python SDK snippet.

Yuki (Security): two compliance points from our side: a) telemetry must be opt-in per-tenant for marketplace bundles, b) we need to ensure no PII is sent in usage payloads. we'll provide a telemetry schema and redaction guidance.

Carlos (Solutions): ToolSmith also wants a datalayer hook so they can surface connector health to their dashboard. propose a read-only /status endpoint on staging that exposes connector_id + last_heartbeat (no token contents).

Maya (Marketing): marketing will need anonymized usage numbers for the joint announcement (buckets like installs, sandbox runs). if telemetry is opt-in, we'll include an explicit consent checkbox on the marketplace page.

Omar (Eng): here's a compact connector manifest example we can share:
```
{
  "name": "toolsmith-langchain-adapter",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "entrypoint": "/connector/register",
  "capabilities": ["indexing","orchestration-callback"]
}
```

Omar (Eng): and a tiny curl to register with staging gateway:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/connectors \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"toolsmith-adapter","manifest_url":"https://toolsmith.com/manifest.json"}'
```

Yuki (Security): telemetry schema: fields = ["bundle_id","tenant_id","event_type","timestamp","metric_value"]. do NOT include user emails, request payloads, or tokens. any payload with potential PII must be filtered client-side before export.

Carlos (Solutions): status endpoint agreement: return {connector_id, status, last_heartbeat} and require a read-only API key scoped to status. OK from infra?

Omar (Eng): yes. we'll add a `status_key` scope that only allows /status. low-risk.

Lena (Partnerships): timeline: ToolSmith wants a sandbox demo next Wed. deliverables: Omar -> manifest + register curl + status endpoint + SDK snippet, Yuki -> telemetry schema + redaction note, Maya -> consent copy and marketing buckets. Can we get this by EOD Mon?

ci-bot: repo-check: partner-repos/toolsmith quickstart CI passed on staging at 2025-02-11T09:14:02Z.

Maya (Marketing): I'll draft the consent copy and example dashboard numbers. ping me when telemetry schema is in PR.

Yuki (Security): will open PR with telemetry schema + redaction examples. adding a malformed-metric test to CI so partners see reject behavior.

Omar (Eng): starting the quickstart PR now. I'll include a minimal node SDK reconnect snippet and the HMAC callback example.

Lena (Partnerships): thanks all — i'll confirm sandbox slot with ToolSmith once PRs land. :rocket:
